entry.title: Lars Vogel: Find blur filters and hidden text in your SVG icons
entry.summary: Our quest to make Eclipse RCP and SWT faster continues. SWT renders SVG icons with JSVG on the UI thread, so everything inside an icon costs time. Two kinds of leftovers turned out to be expensive in the Eclipse platform icons. Gaussian blur filters. JSVG computes every feGaussianBlur on each rasterization. entry.title: JetBrains Joins the Open Source Security Foundation
entry.summary: JetBrains has joined the Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF) as a general member. OpenSSF is a cross-industry initiative of the Linux Foundation that works to secure the software supply chain on which the industry depends. entry.title: VS Code v1_147: Agent experience
entry.summary: Decision model-based model routers (Experimental) Setting:chat.copilot.modelRouter.enabled With a model router, you describe which model you want for which kind of work. A decision model,gpt-6-luna-decisions, then matches your request to one of your routes, and VS Code runs the chat on that route's model. A router is a YAML file in~/.agents/model-routers/that appears in the model picker inCopilot harnesssessions.
